title: CE51004: Biomechanics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Human body â musculo-skeletal system; Principles of continuum mechanics,
Rheology, visco-elasticity. Properties and mechanics of soft and hard tissues
(bones, cartilage, tendon, ligaments and muscles). Idealization of musculoskeletal system; classification of joints and relation to motion;
synarthrodial, amphiarthrodial and diarthrodial.Kinematics and kinetics of
rigid bodies; Euler s equation; Lagrange s equation; spring-mass-dashpot
system; Inverse dynamics, Sports mechanics; Computer simulation of different
athletic activities; Design of prosthetics and other accessories; biomechanical effects of implants on the musculoskeletal system. Introduction to
mechanics of other important organs â lungs, heart and kidney. Simulation
Softwares and virtual reality in medical science for training and educational
purposes.
